about: Questions of the scored Turkish Text set whose stored question points at a passage or dialogue that the extracted question bank does not hold (the book's text was lost at extraction). Found by turkce's quality control (Zeki #5264) from MiniCPM5-2B's English run 1051, whose reply named the missing dialogue; the lead's decision (Zeki #5392): disclose, and keep every score, denominator and the existing uncertain-question filter as first published. Metadata only: no question, passage, option, key or answer text.

bank.note: the version every listed run recorded as its dataset_sha256

source_sha256: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) of the question's stored stem, passage_text, passage_markdown, passage_description, choices_json and visuals_json as the bank holds them; the key is not part of it
